summary: NIP Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K disclosing it regained compliance with Nasdaq's minimum bid price requirement. On July 21, 2026, Nasdaq confirmed the company's ADS closing bid price was at or above $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days (July 7-21, 2026), curing the deficiency noted on March 24, 2026. The matter is closed; no special situation is present.
